👋🏽 Hello, I'm **Yullie Yang** — a quantitative analyst working at the intersection of **economics, data, and engineering**.

📍 Currently in Boston, MA as a **Quantitative Analyst at CoStar Group**, where I own quarterly credit risk forecasting model releases for commercial real estate portfolios — supporting stress testing, scenario analysis, and model performance review using CMBS and loan-level data.

🛠 Before CoStar, I was a **Data Scientist / Consultant at Guidehouse** (Mar 2024 – Jun 2025), building Python/SQL workflows over multi-source federal financial datasets, developing validation logic for recurring financial and compliance reports, and evaluating Azure-based retrieval workflows for an internal chatbot on financial policy documents.

🏛 In summer 2023 I was a **Graduate Intern with the Federal Reserve Board's Division of International Finance** (Integrated Technology Solutions) — building research-support tools, NLP and prompt-experimentation workflows over economic and regulatory documents, and R-based research visualizations.

🎓 **M.S. in Business Analytics**, University of Maryland, College Park (Dec 2023, 3.7 GPA) · **B.A. in Global Political Economy**, Waseda University, Tokyo (Sept 2022, 3.7 GPA).

💡 I focus on **production-style research code**: reproducible R / Python pipelines, model validation and QA, stress testing, forecasting, and responsible AI-assisted review — translating policy-oriented and financial-modeling decisions into versioned, reviewable artifacts.

🧪 I'm increasingly drawn to **experimentation and metrics analysis** — designing and evaluating A/B tests (North Star metrics, power/MDE, CUPED variance reduction, guardrails) and translating results into clear launch and monitoring recommendations. The same validation mindset I apply to risk models is what I bring to product metrics and AI-workflow evaluation.

### Featured projects

+ **[agentic-ai-evaluation-platform](https://github.com/yullieyang/agentic-ai-evaluation-platform)** — a reproducible study of LLM-based QA agents on synthetic model-monitoring anomaly review: 15 labelled scenario types, a deterministic rule baseline, a schema-constrained agent + reviewer agent, four prompt conditions, evaluation with confidence calibration and paired statistical testing (McNemar, permutation, Benjamini–Hochberg), and a Streamlit dashboard. Runs fully offline via a mock provider; 54 passing tests.
+ **[product-ab-experiment](https://github.com/yullieyang/product-ab-experiment)** — end-to-end product-analytics A/B test on 100K users: North Star metric + guardrails, SRM trust check, two-proportion z-test (+0.84pp, p<0.001), power/MDE, CUPED variance reduction, Bonferroni-corrected segmentation, and a ship/no-ship decision memo, plus an ARIMA DAU forecast for monitoring.
+ **[r-macro-trade-commodity-forecast](https://github.com/yullieyang/r-macro-trade-commodity-forecast)** — reproducible R pipeline pulling 13 FRED macro / trade / commodity series into a quarterly panel; derived measures (net exports, implicit trade deflators, terms of trade); 8-quarter `auto.arima` forecasts for net exports, real GDP, and WTI; distributed-lag exchange-rate pass-through regression on U.S. trade prices; CI + Quarto Pages dashboard.
+ **[cre_stress_test](https://github.com/yullieyang/cre_stress_test)** — portfolio-demo stress testing workflow on 100% public data (FRED, Google Mobility, Boston Zoning). Python package + R/auto.arima companion + SQLAlchemy persistence + Streamlit dashboard. Does **not** reflect any employer's internal data or models.
+ **[llm-research-workflow-assistant](https://github.com/yullieyang/llm-research-workflow-assistant)** — reusable prompt templates, sample QC and brief-review outputs, and a human-in-the-loop checklist for using AI coding tools responsibly in recurring research workflows.
+ **[cardnews](https://github.com/yullieyang/cardnews)** — applied LLM tooling demo: Claude API + Puppeteer renders a topic into a 10-slide 1080×1080 deck.
+ **[Predicting Average Housing Starts](housingstarts.html)** — early coursework project: quarterly FRED data + linear regression for 1 / 2 / 4-quarter forecasting.
+ **[Employee Attrition Prediction](employeeattirtionprediction.html)** — early coursework project: KNN / Naive Bayes / Decision Tree / Random Forest comparison with imbalanced-class handling.

+ **Languages:** Python, R, SQL
+ **Frameworks & tools:** tidyverse, ggplot2, pandas, scikit-learn, SQLAlchemy, Streamlit, Power BI, Azure, Git, GitHub Actions, Quarto
+ **Experimentation:** A/B testing, North Star / guardrail metric design, power / MDE analysis, SRM checks, CUPED variance reduction, segmentation with multiple-comparison correction
+ **Domain:** financial model validation, stress testing / scenario analysis, forecasting, policy research support
+ **AI / LLM:** LLM & RAG evaluation, agentic workflows, prompt experimentation, human-in-the-loop systems, retrieval-quality analysis, LangChain, LangGraph, Claude API, Claude Code
